module: Node "Flip Upright" (category `repeat_instant`, tags rotation/position/recover/move). Sets the vehicle upright without repairing it: `spawn.safeTeleport` at the same position with a rotation recomputed by `quatFromDir(direction)`, then triggers the `onVehicleFlippedUpright(vehId)` hook. Input pin: `vehId`. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: Called every frame while the flow is active.
The last argument `false` of safeTeleport disables repair.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

resetVehicle.desc: Teleports the vehicle in place, upright, and calls `extensions.hook('onVehicleFlippedUpright', vehId)`.

work.desc: Calls `resetVehicle` and copies the input flow to the output.
